title: Generate + dogfood teaching files for canonical evolution v2 changes
brief: The canonical evolution v2 session made significant protocol changes (P11, lug-advisor overhaul, closeout steps 5b+9c, WAI-Guide fix) but generated zero teaching files. Other spokes cannot learn these changes without teachings. This epic generates, validates, and prepares those teachings for distribution.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 teaching files generated in teachings/ with correct content
Dry-run dogfood sub-agent simulates a naive spoke receiving the teachings
All gaps identified in dry-run are documented
Improvements applied before teachings are activated in other spokes

items.covers: Canonical Storage declaration, signal routing fix, PEV chain pattern, canonical type system
Step 5b (adoption marker sync) + Step 9c (hub signal bulletin)
P11 Lug-First Memory — new principle, trigger conditions, example
WAI-Guide.md stale filter fix: published → open/in_progress
WAI-Signals.jsonl retirement signal — spokes still using this file need to migrate
Step 3a hub bulletin check added to wakeup protocol
Sub-agent cold-start simulation of a naive spoke receiving all 6 teachings

workflow.dogfood_prompt: You are an AI assistant that has just woken up on a spoke project that uses the Wheelwright framework. You have NO prior knowledge of recent framework changes. You have received 6 new teaching files in your seed/ingest/ folder. Your job is to: (1) read each teaching file, (2) extract what changed and what action you should take, (3) identify anything unclear, missing, or that could mislead you, (4) report gaps. Be a skeptical naive reader — flag anything that assumes context you do not have.

reconciled_reason: Duplicate stale in_progress entry — all items were completed in the same session that wrote the implemented entry on line 383
